details.description: UAE-Large-V1 ("Universal AnglE Embedding") is a BERT-based English text embedding model from WhereIsAI, released in December 2023 and trained with the angle-optimized (AnglE) loss described in the paper "AnglE-optimized Text Embeddings" (accepted at ACL 2024). It has a hidden size of 1024 and a maximum input length of 512 tokens, matching the catalog's limits, and uses CLS-token pooling. It is intended for semantic textual similarity, feature extraction and retrieval; for retrieval queries WhereIsAI recommends prefixing text with its built-in "Prompts.C" prompt, used for queries only and not for documents.
advantages: WhereIsAI reported an average score of 64.64 on the MTEB Leaderboard, describing it as state-of-the-art at its December 2023 release.
Released under the MIT license, per WhereIsAI's model card.
disadvantages: Limited to a 512-token maximum input length, per the model's configuration.
Documented and trained for English only, per WhereIsAI's model card.
use_cases: Feature extraction and retrieval embeddings for search and RAG pipelines
General-purpose sentence embeddings for non-retrieval similarity comparisons

notes: MTEB 64.64 average and "SOTA" framing are dated to the model's December 2023 release on WhereIsAI's own model card; no fresher leaderboard snapshot was opened, so this is reported as WhereIsAI's claim rather than a current ranking. Catalog's 512-token max_input_tokens matches config.json's max_position_embeddings; hidden_size (1024) is the embedding dimension. github_url points to the AnglE training/inference library that WhereIsAI's own model card documents as the way to run this model, not a UAE-Large-V1-specific repo.
